subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class N-turn model lease, or should cost-governance stay limited to a one-turn override or another narrower model-routing policy?
rationale: This changes slash command syntax, model routing, session state, and config defaults, and it overlaps with existing one-turn and image auto-revert proposals that need a single product contract.

options.title: Define N-turn lease contract
options.body: Specify `/model --turns N`, warning timing, revert target, session storage, and config/default rules, then implement it as core model-routing behavior.

options.title: Use one-turn override only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876 handle atomic single-turn escalation and narrow or close this issue if N-turn leases are not desired.

options.title: Defer native governance
options.body: Keep manual model switches and usage reporting as the supported path until stronger demand justifies new config and session-state machinery.

recommendation.title: Define N-turn lease contract
recommendation.body: Specify `/model --turns N`, warning timing, revert target, session storage, and config/default rules, then implement it as core model-routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: @bcperry authored the current model/session routing surfaces most directly implicated by the requested API shape.
